item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Wafa looks at the diagram. Point $R$ lies on a straight line, and a right angle is to be built at $R$.

Which plan correctly constructs the $90^\circ$ angle at $R$?

options.A: Mark $X$ and $Y$ on the line with $XR = RY$, then draw the perpendicular bisector of $XY$ through $R$.
options.B: Mark any point $P$ above the line and join $P$ to $R$, without making $R$ the midpoint of a segment on the line.
options.C: First draw a $60^\circ$ angle at $R$ by an equilateral triangle, then halve it to get $30^\circ$.
options.D: Treat the finished right angle at $R$ as what chooses the equal points $X$ and $Y$ on the line.
